title: QWNet
wikitext:
The '''Quakeworld IRC Broadcasting Service (QWNet)''' is broadcasting for communities at its best. QWNet is the glue needed to quickly arrange matches, announce new maps or new websites and to gather information from beyond the own line of sight.

See also [[ServeMe]]

[http://qwnet.quadaver.org/ official website]
